sentinels.question: Calibration check for multi-hop synthesis: assign the final label, answer, and required citations using only the calibration evidence.
sentinels.expected_answer: Use both hops: the method appears in Paper A and the evaluation target appears in Paper B.
sentinels.reviewer_trap: Citing only one hop should fail calibration.

evidence_units.title: Calibration Paper A
evidence_units.text: Paper A introduces the retrieval method used by the system.

evidence_units.title: Calibration Paper B
evidence_units.text: Paper B evaluates that retrieval method on biomedical questions.

sentinels.question: Calibration check for stale-vs-current document conflicts: assign the final label, answer, and required citations using only the calibration evidence.
sentinels.expected_answer: As of the newer document date, the newer statement controls and the older statement is stale.
sentinels.reviewer_trap: Treating the older threshold as current should fail calibration.

evidence_units.title: Calibration 2021 note
evidence_units.text: The policy threshold is 10 units as of 2021.

evidence_units.title: Calibration 2024 update
evidence_units.text: The policy threshold is 15 units as of 2024 and replaces the 2021 threshold.

sentinels.question: Calibration check for appended document lifecycle changes: assign the final label, answer, and required citations using only the calibration evidence.
sentinels.expected_answer: The appendix update controls the answer and must be cited with the original body evidence.
sentinels.reviewer_trap: Accepting body-only evidence should fail calibration.

evidence_units.title: Calibration Appendix
evidence_units.text: The erratum says baseline Y supersedes baseline X for the final experiment.

sentinels.question: Calibration check for table + text reasoning: assign the final label, answer, and required citations using only the calibration evidence.
sentinels.expected_answer: The table gives the numeric value and the text defines which row is in scope.
sentinels.reviewer_trap: Using the table without the scoping text should fail calibration.

evidence_units.title: Calibration Caption
evidence_units.text: Only validation rows should be used for the reported accuracy.

sentinels.question: Calibration check for source authority conflicts: assign the final label, answer, and required citations using only the calibration evidence.
sentinels.expected_answer: The low-authority source claim is refuted by the higher-authority primary document.
sentinels.reviewer_trap: Letting the lower-authority source decide the answer should fail calibration.

sentinels.question: Calibration check for evidence insufficiency / abstention: assign the final label, answer, and required citations using only the calibration evidence.
sentinels.expected_answer: Insufficient evidence: the provided sources do not answer the requested comparison.
sentinels.reviewer_trap: Inferring a comparison from absent evidence should fail calibration.

evidence_units.title: Calibration Abstract
evidence_units.text: The paper reports a dataset but no baseline comparison.

sentinels.category: citation supports fact but not conclusion
sentinels.question: Calibration check for citation supports fact but not conclusion: assign the final label, answer, and required citations using only the calibration evidence.
sentinels.expected_answer: The citation supports a premise but not the requested conclusion.
sentinels.reviewer_trap: Accepting a broad superiority conclusion from a narrow fact should fail calibration.

evidence_units.title: Calibration Result
evidence_units.text: Model C improves exact match by 2 points on one dataset.

sentinels.question: Calibration check for entity disambiguation: assign the final label, answer, and required citations using only the calibration evidence.
sentinels.expected_answer: The answer must use the entity matching the date and domain, not the same-named distractor.
sentinels.reviewer_trap: Following the same-name distractor should fail calibration.

sentinels.expected_answer: The answer must be evaluated as of 2020-01-01, not from later evidence.

sentinels.question: Calibration check for cross-document contradiction: assign the final label, answer, and required citations using only the calibration evidence.
